name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Compact two-platform metro terminus for reversible lightrail on ordinary electric tramtrack.
description: Adds Metro Terminus, a compact tram-based terminus with two 80m side platforms and an optional scissors crossover. Connect ordinary native electric tramtrack at the double front entrance and use a reversible lightrail vehicle such as Citylink. The development test covered passenger access and boarding, native reversal, two busy crossing lines, multiple vehicles waiting and proceeding at occupied switch routes, and save/reload persistence. This remains an early mod with limited test coverage; station visuals and internal catenary are unfinished. Version 0.7.0 removes obsolete experiment resources and automatic diagnostics. The working station and its internal approach keep their resource IDs, parameter indices, costs and geometry, so current working stations remain compatible. Older experiment objects must be removed before loading this cleaned version. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
